title: Juicy Roasted Syrian Lamb Roast
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring a yeasty, crumbly lamb roast served with a sweet and tangy plum sauce, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb shoulder in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is roasting, mix the plum sauce with 1 tablespoon of water in a small saucepan.
Bring the plum sauce to a simmer over medium heat and let it cook for 5 minutes.
Once the lamb is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Serve the lamb with the plum sauce spooned over the top.
